load_conv2d_with_weights: load a Conv2d layer with weight and bias from a weights object using accelerate init_empty_weights
load_conv2d_no_bias: load a Conv2d layer with only weight (no bias) from a weights object using accelerate init_empty_weights
monkey_patch_conv2d_load: monkey-patch torch.nn.Conv2d with a load classmethod to load weights from a checkpoint
create_conv2d_from_checkpoint: create a Conv2d layer from checkpoint tensors by calling torch.nn.Conv2d.load with prefix and weights
create_conv2d_no_bias_from_checkpoint: create a Conv2d layer without bias from checkpoint tensors by calling torch.nn.Conv2d.load_no_bias
